teardownBurn

Final session teardown — restores the DOM title's ink, drops the burn canvas + rewrite slot, and detaches the session from its card. Runs when a reversed (rebuild) pass reaches progress 0; the pristine raster painted that frame is pixel-identical to the restored DOM text, so the handoff is seamless.

  • @param s The finished session — torn down in place.

frame

One combustion frame: rebuild the burned paper (char → glow → consume, per letter), blit it, spawn + draw particles. When every letter's front has passed its ink top the title is ash; the loop idles until the last particle dies. Reversed sessions (dir −1) count progress down — the stage climbs bottom→top again, re-inking each letter base-to-cap while deposit particles rain onto the moving edge until the raster is whole again and the DOM takes the pixels back.

  • @param s The live session — self-reschedules on requestAnimationFrame.
